user.title: DynTarNL — choose your supplier
user.description: Choose your energy supplier. The integration figures out which platform and price API to use. Supplier not listed? Choose 'Custom supplier (manual)'.

custom.title: Custom supplier
custom.description:
Useful for suppliers without a public API, such as Vattenfall, Eneco, Tibber, Greenchoice, Zonneplan, ENGIE, DELTA, Vandebron, OXXIO and others.

The integration fetches the bare EPEX market price and computes the all-in price itself. Enter your tariffs excluding VAT; VAT is applied on top.

all-in = (EPEX + markup + energy tax) × (1 + VAT%)

data_description.epex_source: Where the bare market price comes from. For electricity it is identical everywhere; for gas it differs slightly per source. Unsure? Leave easyEnergy.

refresh.name: Refresh tariffs
refresh.description: Fetches the dynamic tariffs again right away.

get_prices.name: Get prices
get_prices.description: Returns the full price series (published prices, optionally extended with forecasts) as response data. Electricity per quarter hour, gas per gas day.

energy.name: Energy
energy.description: electricity or gas (gas: published prices only).

include_forecast.name: Include forecast
include_forecast.description: Extend with forecasts (only when the forecast option is on).

provider.name: Source
provider.description: ensemble (default), a single source (epexpredictor, energypriceforecast) or all (also returns each source series separately).

horizon.name: Horizon
horizon.description: Only quarters up to this many hours from now.

init.title: Price forecasts
init.description: Optionally extend the published day-ahead prices with EPEX price forecasts from external sources, up to 7 days ahead. Off by default: when off, nothing changes (no extra API calls, no extra entities).

forecast.title: Forecast settings
forecast.description: Forecasts are always fetched as the bare EPEX price; your supplier's formula (markup, energy tax, VAT) is applied by DynTarNL. Published prices always win over forecasts.

data_description.forecast_ensemble: Off = only the separate source series; sensors then use the first source in the list that has a value.
data_description.forecast_weighting: Automatic = sources that turned out more accurate weigh more. Requires accuracy measurement.
data_description.forecast_accuracy: Compares every forecast with the price that is published later. Needed for automatic weighting and the expected error.
data_description.forecast_horizon_hours: Energy Price Forecast EU delivers at most 48 h without an API key (120 h with one); EpexPredictor about 7 days.
data_description.forecast_interval_hours: How often each source is asked. These are free services: a few times a day is plenty.

provider_settings.title: Source settings
provider_settings.description: Settings per selected source. They are checked with one test call.

data.forecast_energypriceforecast_api_key: Energy Price Forecast EU API key (optional)

data_description.forecast_epexpredictor_url: Public instance or your own (e.g. a local container or add-on).
data_description.forecast_energypriceforecast_api_key: Without a key the horizon is at most 48 hours.

data_description.forecast_min_samples: Until every source has this many settled quarters, all sources weigh the same (96 = one day).
data_description.forecast_weight_floor: Share (0–0.5) a source always keeps, so it can earn back its weight after a bad period.
data_description.forecast_bias_correction: Subtract each source's measured systematic error before averaging.
data_description.forecast_window_days: Accuracy is measured over this many most recent days.
data_description.forecast_cheapest_hours: Used by the 'cheapest block start' sensor (next 48 hours, forecasts included).

error.weighting_needs_accuracy: Automatic weighting needs accuracy measurement turned on.
